findings.highlight: A desert as far as I can see
findings.evidenceJa: 見渡すかぎりの荒野
findings.governingReading: a wasteland as far as the eye can see
findings.explanation: Archer’s barren inner landscape is changed from wasteland to desert.

findings.evidenceJa: 空は荒れ果て
findings.governingReading: the sky is laid waste
findings.explanation: Desolation is replaced by weather.

findings.highlight: there is no forest, town, or sea within my sight
findings.evidenceJa: 遠く地平の彼方には森も町も海もない
findings.governingReading: far beyond the horizon there is neither forest, town, nor sea
findings.explanation: The image’s limitless geography is reduced to the observer’s present line of sight.

findings.evidenceJa: 様々な経緯を経て
findings.governingReading: through many different courses of circumstance
findings.explanation: The English copies an abstract noun into an unnatural phrase.

findings.evidenceJa: 満ち足りた余生を終えて消えた
findings.governingReading: passed away after completing a fulfilled remainder of life
findings.explanation: A completed, contented old age is collapsed into an emotional state at death.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間は守護者として使役する
findings.governingReading: we humans employ them as Guardians
findings.explanation: Humanity’s agency in putting even hated spirits to service disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: それも[ruby text=まもう char=2]摩耗した
findings.governingReading: even that was worn away
findings.explanation: Archer’s moral erosion becomes mere expiration.

findings.evidenceJa: きっと摩耗したんだ
findings.governingReading: surely it was worn away
findings.explanation: Cumulative erosion of the self becomes ordinary tiredness.

findings.evidenceJa: 霊長の抑止力
findings.governingReading: the Counter Force of the primates
findings.explanation: A work-specific metaphysical mechanism becomes a generic controlling power.

findings.highlight: Naturally, destruction brought on by an outside factor
findings.evidenceJa: 自然、外的要因による破滅
findings.governingReading: destruction by nature or other external causes
findings.explanation: The noun “nature” is misparsed as the adverb “naturally.”

findings.evidenceJa: 代償として守護者になった
findings.governingReading: as the price, he became a Guardian
findings.explanation: Archer’s specific posthumous role is generalized to Heroic Spirit.

findings.highlight: betrayed by the ideal that he protected unto death
findings.evidenceJa: 死んだ後さえ、守った筈の理想に裏切られ続けた
findings.governingReading: even after death, he continued to be betrayed by the ideal he thought he had protected
findings.explanation: The endless posthumous betrayal is shifted into protection lasting until death.

findings.highlight: And you didn’t wake me up?
findings.evidenceJa: 起こさないなんて人が悪いわね
findings.governingReading: not waking me was rather mean of you
findings.explanation: Rin’s teasing accusation disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 気にくわないだの頭にくるだの
findings.governingReading: things like “I don’t like it” and “it makes me angry”
findings.explanation: Two distinct muttered complaints are collapsed into one generic emotion.

findings.highlight: Archer silently protects from behind her
findings.evidenceJa: 無言で背後を守るアーチャー
findings.governingReading: Archer silently guards her back
findings.explanation: The English loses the object of “protects” and produces malformed staging.

findings.highlight: will follow her path until the very end
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まであっさりと自分の道を信じられる
findings.governingReading: can believe in her own path effortlessly to the end
findings.explanation: Archer’s praise of Rin’s unforced conviction is weakened to persistence.

findings.highlight: The knight in the red cloak praises her
findings.evidenceJa: 歌うように、赤い外套の騎士は言った
findings.governingReading: the knight in the red cloak said it as though singing
findings.explanation: A musical delivery cue becomes a narrator judgment that Archer praises Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: 核心を口にする
findings.governingReading: voices the heart of the matter
findings.explanation: Rin’s decisive move to the central question becomes generic continuation.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分が正しいって信じられる
findings.governingReading: believe that you are right
findings.explanation: The moral proposition under discussion is softened into self-confidence.

findings.evidenceJa: 乾いた声で
findings.governingReading: replies in a dry voice
findings.explanation: Archer’s emotionally desiccated delivery at the reveal disappears.
